description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, providing basic endpoints for the kycservice application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message for the kycservice.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation, preserving original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple OK string indicating application health status.
